rows.grounds: genitive plural of dhāman, shrine or abode
instrumental plural of samastabhūṣā, all ornaments
instrumental plural feminine of anya, other
past participle of samalaṃkṛ, well decorated; nominative singular neuter

items.question: How should a shrine be adorned with ornaments and other decorations?
premises: Shrines are adorned with all ornaments.
items.inference: The verse prescribes complete ornamentation of shrines using all and other ornaments.
uncertainties: Exact referent of dhāman as shrine or abode is uncertain.
samalaṃkṛtam may modify the shrine or the whole structure.
items.plain_english: Shrines are to be well decorated with all ornaments and other ornaments.
